Passengers escape as buses catch fire in separate incidents

Two separate bus fires occurred, with all passengers escaping unharmed. In Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, a tourist bus carrying 33 to 37 passengers caught fire. In a separate incident in Piravom, Kerala, a car also caught fire, with its occupants escaping safely. The causes of the fires were not specified in the coverage.
